messages:
Ana (People Ops): Quick share — built a 15min manager prep + async calibration snippet for the upcoming performance cycle. Bite-sized prompts for self-review, 1:1 agenda, and a short rubric. Use freely and tweak. :sparkles:

Jamal (Engineering Manager): Awesome, will use next week. can you make the rubric 3-tier so ICs are clearer?

Ana (People Ops): Yep, kept it 3-tier (Exceeds / Meets / Needs Growth). Short descriptors so managers can score quickly. Example below.

Lisa (Eng): Can we add a one-sentence coaching tip per tier? helps new managers.

Ana (People Ops): Good call — added one-liners and a tiny checklist for 1:1s (questions + evidence to collect).

Sanjay (People Ops Lead): If we plan calibration, include a 10-min pre-read template for managers to paste in? saves time.

Ana (People Ops): Done. Pasted everything below — copy/paste friendly. Happy to make a Google Slide if folks want visuals.

hr-bot: Reminder: performance cycle kickoff doc: https://redwood.internal/perf/kickoff — cycle opens in 5 days.

Ana (People Ops): [SNIPPET — Manager 15min prep + Async calibration pack]

1) Quick manager prep (15 min)
- Read employee self-review highlights (3 bullets) — 2 min
- Review last-cycle goals + 1 recent deliverable/examples — 5 min
- Rate on rubric (Exceeds / Meets / Needs Growth) with 1-sentence rationale — 3 min
- Draft 1:1 agenda with >=1 coaching question and 1 action item — 5 min

2) Suggested 1:1 agenda (30 min)
- 5m: check-in + one win
- 10m: discuss self-review highlights + clarify examples
- 10m: development/career conversation (ask: what would you pursue next?)
- 5m: agree next steps + owner/timeline

3) Self-review highlights prompt (send to ICs)
- Paste 3 short bullets: 1) top contribution, 2) biggest learning, 3) one ask from your manager. <=140 chars each.

4) Simple 3-tier rubric (copyable)
- Exceeds: Consistently delivered beyond expectations; examples show impact and ownership. Coaching tip: call out specific behaviors to replicate.
- Meets: Delivered expected outcomes reliably; examples cover quality and timeliness. Coaching tip: acknowledge and set a small stretch.
- Needs Growth: Outcomes not consistently met; examples show gaps. Coaching tip: focus on one concrete skill and next-step with timeline.

5) One-sentence rationale template (for managers)
- "Rating: [Tier]. Evidence: [one concrete example]. Next step: [action + owner + timeline]."

6) Async calibration pre-read (copy for each manager)
- Employee: [Name]
- Role/Level: [Role / Level]
- Manager provisional rating: [Tier]
- 2-3 sentence summary of evidence and risk areas
- Anything to surface in calibration: [e.g., competing work, ambiguous metrics]

7) Quick examples (paste into convo)
- Self-review: "Led cross-team rollout of caching layer; reduced p95 from 450ms -> 220ms; mentored 2 junior devs."
- Manager rationale: "Meets. Delivered feature with measurable latency wins; needs clearer handoff docs for scale."

Jamal (Engineering Manager): This is great. I might shorten the pre-read to a bullet list for faster scanning.

Ana (People Ops): Go for it — aim is <10m/person in calibration.

Lisa (Eng): Can the form enforce the 140-char bullets? we still get essays.

Ana (People Ops): We can limit characters on the Google Form. Will update and link in the kickoff doc.

Sanjay (People Ops Lead): Thanks Ana — can you add this to the manager playbook and weekly roundup?

Ana (People Ops): On it. cc @Jamal if you want eng-specific wording. :thumbsup:
